name: B10-0257/2026 (PPE) – The cases of human rights and environmental defenders Andrie Yunus and Muhammad Rosidi in Indonesia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the cases of human rights and environmental defenders Andrie Yunus and Muhammad Rosidi in Indonesia
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns acid attacks on two Indonesian activists: Andrie Yunus, a human rights campaigner attacked in Jakarta in March 2026, and Muhammad Rosidi, who campaigns against illegal tin mining and was attacked in February 2026. It calls for quick, open investigations and fair trials. It welcomes Indonesia's promises to act, notes that soldiers have been charged over the Yunus attack, and says no one has yet been arrested for the Rosidi attack. The text is a statement of position, not a law.

- **What changes:** Nothing in law. Parliament states its position and calls for transparent investigations and fair trials.
- **Who it affects:** The two activists, Indonesian police, courts and military prosecutors, and Indonesia's government.
- **What happens next:** Parliament sends the text to EU institutions and to Indonesia's government and parliament.
